ability-counter-fixture.name: Ability Counter
ability-counter-fixture.rulesText: Counter target activated or triggered ability.

choice-practice.name: Choice practice
choice-practice.rulesText: Choose X from 0 to 4. Pay X mana or 2 life, then pay one red mana and discard a card. Target opponent loses X life.

trigger-probe.name: Trigger Probe
trigger-probe.rulesText: TEST CARD. Spell instructions: draw 1, then gain 1 life. Entry/block: gain 1. Attack: target opponent loses 1. Death: draw 1. Another creature you control enters: gain 1; dies: draw 1. Cast another creature: gain 1. Draw: gain 1. {R}: destroy target creature. No Aura or ability-resolved trigger support implied.
